ms.promise:
Approach: https://clik.vc/tribaldaoapproachtimeline
1. Project plan outlining key tasks and timelines
2. Initial list of key Māori community leaders and relevant experts
3. Brief research summary on DAO structures and their potential adaptation for Māori context
4. Draft outline of the proposed TribalDAO structure
5. Basic concept for TribalDAO tokenomics
6. Kick-off meeting summary
ms.criteria:
1. A project plan that details the next 6 months with activities, outputs, roles, resources
2. Stakeholder list includes representatives from at least 3 different Māori Hāpu (tribes)
3. Research summary cites at least 5 relevant sources
4. Proposed structure will outline some of the proposed concepts – how, why, pros, and cons, basic concepts around how to set them up, risks, opportunities, interoperability
5. Identified at least 3 tribal activity/asset management instances in which a tribal DAO could benefit from tokenomics
6. A kickoff team has been held with project team, community members
